_meta.purpose: Made-up Quick Quiz submissions for tests and demo pages. Not real clients. Names, emails (example.com), phone numbers (555-01xx) and street addresses are fictional.
_meta.answers: Keys are question ids from questions.json. Pick-one questions take an option id, pick-several questions take a list of option ids, text questions take text, slider questions take a number (or an option id such as "not_sure"). A missing question means it was skipped.
_meta.note: Each sample's 'note' says who it is meant to represent, so a reviewer can check the brief against the intent.

samples.note: Clear Decisive Delegator. Hot lead: renovation at $200K, ready in 3-6 months, full service, in Burnaby. Finished fast with short answers.
Clear Analytical Validator. Hot lead: new build at $500K+ in Vancouver, 6-12 months out. Took their time and wrote a long, detailed answer.

answers.home_meaning: Home is where everything has a reason to be where it is. We want a house that performs well for decades: good air quality, low energy bills, materials that age well, and a layout we have actually thought through rather than inherited. We have read a lot about Passive House and want to understand the trade-offs.

samples.note: Mixed blend: Cautious Reassurance Seeker and Hands-On Controller. Warm lead: renovation at $100K in Coquitlam, wants to start ASAP, unsure what service they need.

answers.home_meaning: Somewhere the kids can grow up and my mom can come stay with us.

samples.note: Leans Creative Collaborator. Cold lead: furniture and styling only with no budget in mind (starts warm), then lowered by three warning signs: just exploring, wants a one-time session, still collecting ideas. In Kelowna, which has no effect.

answers.home_meaning: Colour, plants, and a big table for friends.
